name: Graph theory
description: Introduction to graphs; Trees and distance: properties, spanning trees and enumeration etc.; Matchings and covers; Connectivity: cuts, vertex/edge connectivity, Menger's theorem, etc.; Network flow; Graph coloring: vertex coloring, Brooks' theorem, color critical graphs etc.; Planar graphs: Embeddings, Euler Formula, Kuratowski's theorem, coloring of planar graphs etc.; Line graphs and edge coloring; Hamiltonian cycles; Special classes of graphs: chordal graphs, interval graphs, perfect graphs etc.
